notes: Second occurrence of the same cross-client lockout, right after Kevin checked the app to confirm nanoex=false -- strong second data point for the confirmed theory in 02's notes.

Practical workflow note for the rest of this session: checking the app to confirm a change appears to re-arm the 2-minute lockout, which then blocks the NEXT CLI write. Confirming in the app right after each CLI write (rather than before the next one) doesn't cost anything extra, but confirming and then immediately trying another CLI write does. Waiting out the lockout each time works fine, just costs ~2 minutes per cycle.
